name: Omarchygram
author: leoom
description: Unread badge and call state for the Omarchygram Telegram client.

barWidget.description: Unread badge and call state for the Omarchygram Telegram client.

schema.label: Bar icon
schema.description: Bar glyph; it must exist in the bar font.

schema.label: Show unread count
schema.description: Show the unread number instead of a dot.

schema.label: Count muted chats
schema.description: Include unread messages and chats from muted chats.

schema.label: Hide when idle
schema.description: Hide while Omarchygram is live with no unread messages or call.

schema.label: Application ID
schema.description: Wayland application ID of the Omarchygram window.

schema.label: Launch command
schema.description: Shell command line to run when no Omarchygram window exists.

schema.label: Status file path
schema.description: Optional absolute status file path; leave empty to use the standard state directory.
